about: Step 0.3 of GwzTransportWindowsParityPlan.md: every Unix-only gate and OS call in the transport, and every runtime platform split, with an owner step and a state. One <step>.json per first-owner step plus this file; read check_windows_parity.py's docstring.

step_notes.0.5b: The TLS fixture on Windows: https_fixture.rs's servers are rustls over ring (test-only dev-dependencies of the candidate manifest, tests/transport_backend/prepare.py), because under dabeest's key-based OpenSSH logon schannel cannot load a server identity (DPAPI and persisted key containers are denied: Protect, CAPI and CNG all fail with Access is denied, so native_tls Identity::from_pkcs12 and from_pkcs8 both fail). The clients under test stay native-tls and verify against the fixture CA. Added by the lane, not in plan revision 3.
